faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does residential interior design in Chhattarpur cover?

It covers layout planning, kitchens, wardrobes, bathrooms, lighting, false ceilings, flooring, furniture and décor for apartments, independent homes and farmhouses.

Can you design only a few rooms?

Yes. We can design a single room, a kitchen or a full home. Partial projects are planned so they match the rest of the house.

How long does a home interior project take?

Timelines depend on the size of the home and the scope of work. We share a schedule with the design so you know when each stage will be done.

Why plan residential interior design before civil work?

When layout, electrical points, plumbing and furniture are planned first, there is less breaking and rework on site, which saves time and money.
